panels.title: dev-042: температура, среднее за час (CAGG telemetry_1h)

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, avg_v AS "среднее", max_v AS "максимум" FROM telemetry_1h WHERE device_id = 'dev-042' AND metric_id = 1 AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Парк: средняя температура по суткам (CAGG telemetry_1d)

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, sum(avg_v * n) / sum(n) AS "температура" FROM telemetry_1d WHERE metric_id = 1 AND $__timeFilter(bucket) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.device_id AS "устройство", l.ts AS "время", max(l.value) FILTER (WHERE l.metric_id = 1) AS "°C", max(l.value) FILTER (WHERE l.metric_id = 2) AS "%RH", max(l.value) FILTER (WHERE l.metric_id = 3) AS "гПа" FROM devices d CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts, metric_id, value FROM telemetry t WHERE t.device_id = d.device_id AND t.ts > now() - interval '1 hour' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 4) l WHERE d.device_id <= 'dev-010' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2 DESC

SELECT to_char(time_bucket('1 day', ts), 'MM-DD') AS "сутки", count(*) AS "аномалий" FROM telemetry WHERE metric_id = 1 AND value > 32 AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time_bucket('1 day', ts) ORDER BY time_bucket('1 day', ts)
